names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 19 Φεβρουαρίου, «Άγιοι Μάξιμος, Θεόδοτος, Ησύχιος και Ασκληπιοδότη», with the rank word left off. Beside the gloss the page prints a note that is not about a saint at all: a philosopher of Tyre of the second century after Christ, and a philosopher of the fourth century before.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 19 февраля ст. ст., «Максим Адрианопольский, мч.», with the rank word left off. The day's own line gives the four of them in one list and this name bare inside it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 февраля ст. ст. — «Мчч. Максима, Феодота, Исихия, мц. Асклипиодоты (305-311).»

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).
